registered_before: any held-out or session task exists

evaluation.unit: task-clustered: samples are averaged within a task, then tasks are averaged; 95% percentile bootstrap over tasks, 4000 rounds, seed 7

selected_guide_beats_current_docs.comparison: xsh-selected minus xsh-baseline on matched held-out tasks and samples
selected_guide_beats_current_docs.passes_when: either target holds and the guard holds

targets.measure: total tokens per solved task (all trials' tokens, failed ones included, over solved trials)

selected_guide_beats_current_docs.undefined: a condition with no solved trial has undefined tokens per solved task; the token target cannot then pass for it
selected_guide_beats_current_docs.reading: pilot thresholds over 8 tasks: report the point estimates with their intervals; an interval that spans zero makes the result inconclusive, not negative

xsh_versus_typescript: reported independently for xsh-baseline and xsh-selected against ts, per track; no pass/fail threshold
sessions: reported separately from static rates; no threshold
